claims.claim: B previously made an affirmative statement that A can arrive in time.

evidence.quote: Are you sure that I can get there in time

claims.repair_of: B previously gave a definite affirmative assurance (not merely a probability) that A can arrive in time.
claims.verifier_basis: The construction 'Are you sure that P' linguistically presupposes that the addressee (B) previously asserted P. Here P is 'I can get there in time,' so B is presupposed to have affirmatively stated that A can arrive in time. The qualifier 'if we take the less heavy route' in the same sentence indicates a conditional refinement, but the base presupposition that B affirmed timeliness holds.
